programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

Along the way, he recruits a broken down, drunk prospector to help him track down the unknown tribe and rescue his sister.

programme.title: Reverend's Colt
programme.desc: Reverend Miller arrives in Tucson where he wants to build a church, but on the very day of his arrival a gang raids the bank and the people of Tucson, suspicious of the new reverend because he is carrying a gun, immediately blame him for the robbery.

programme.title: His Name was King
programme.desc: A relentless bounty hunter pursues a brutal gang of gunrunners deep into Mexico. As he crosses the lawless borderlands, he’s drawn into a deadly chase where justice and vengeance blur in the desert heat.

programme.title: Shango
programme.desc: Shango is a Texas Ranger who finds himself up against a former Confederate officer and his gang of thugs who have been terrorizing a local border town in search of gold.

programme.title: Poker with Pistols
programme.desc: After losing everything in a poker game, Lucas takes a risky job delivering a wagon to Chamaco for $5000. But what seems like an easy deal turns into a deadly trap as he crosses paths with ruthless bandits, a corrupt town boss, and a charming saloon girl whose loyalties may not be what they seem.

programme.title: Wanted
programme.desc: A local sheriff is unjustly accused of murder in a small town and forced to flee.

programme.title: Two Brothers in Trinity
programme.desc: After inheriting a land plot in a dusty place called Trinity, the antagonistic half-brothers, Lester and Jesse, reunite to pursue different aspirations, only to find themselves neck-deep in trouble. Will they ever fulfil their dreams?

programme.title: Watch Out Gringo! Sabata Will Return
programme.desc: After a daring gold robbery, bandit Carrancho double-crosses his gang and hides the loot in a grave. As ruthless outlaws and gunmen close in, the chase for the stolen treasure turns into a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Buddy Goes West
programme.desc: Two outlaws, "The Doctor" and the Indian Girolamo, help a village fight a gang and a corrupt sheriff who has discovered gold beneath the town.

programme.title: Night of the Serpent
programme.desc: In a corrupt Mexican village, Commander Hernandez and his men plot to steal young Manuel’s inheritance. When the broken ex-gunslinger Luke is drawn into their scheme by the revolutionary Pancho, betrayal and vengeance ignite in a tale of greed and redemption.

programme.title: Death Knows No Time
programme.desc: A poor Mexican farmer, evicted from his land, turns to banditry and ends up in prison. While he serves his sentence, his young son is adopted by a wealthy family. Once freed, he sets out to reclaim both his child and the $200,000 he hid after a bank robbery, facing a struggle between love and greed.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, a farmhand, accidentally impersonates the notorious outlaw "Bloody" Ben Harris. Now, on a treasure hunt, he must rely on a group of wild misfits to outsmart the outlaw he's pretending to be. With Harris hot on his trail, Jack must find the treasure and return to his true love, Olivia, before it’s too late.

programme.title: The White, the Yellow and the Black
programme.desc: In the 19th century, when the Japanese Emperor sends a gift pony to the US President it gets stolen and ransomed by Indians but Sheriff Gideon aided by an inept Japanese servant offers to deliver the ransom.

programme.title: California
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Michael "California" Random, is released from prison and goes to Missouri with his partner William.

programme.title: The Desperado Trail
programme.desc: After the Civil War, renegade Rollins and his gang stir conflict between settlers and Native Americans. Apache chief Winnetou and his friend Old Shatterhand try to preserve peace, but Winnetou is framed for the murder of Chief White Buffalo’s son using his own knife. Old Shatterhand must uncover the truth and clear his friend’s name.

programme.title: Dead are Countless
programme.desc: As a child, Johnny witnessed his father’s death at the hands of soldiers. Now an outlaw, he seeks revenge by killing soldiers whenever possible. Lieutenant Garringo is tasked with capturing Johnny and bringing him back alive. A dangerous game of cat and mouse ensues, with Garringo determined to fulfill his mission.

programme.title: Twenty Paces to Death
programme.desc: A young half-breed is saved from death and raised as a son by his rescuer. Years later, love and betrayal tear the family apart when he falls for his adoptive sister, while a vengeful woman plots the downfall of the man who once saved them both.

programme.title: A Pistol for Django
programme.desc: When Django’s fiancée is kidnapped by the ruthless Cortez brothers after a bank robbery, he joins forces with an American ally and agent Fulton, who’s tasked with recovering the stolen gold. Together, they face the gang hiding in a remote cave for a perilous rescue and revenge mission.

programme.title: A Few Bullets More
programme.desc: Billy starts as an innocent outlaw protecting his mother but soon becomes a ruthless killer. When love gives him hope for change, Pat Garrett, a fatherly friend, helps him try to turn his life around. Yet fate drags Billy back into violence, and Garrett is ultimately credited with his death.

programme.title: They Called Him Trinity
programme.desc: An ex-sheriff sets out to find the bandits who beat and murdered his sister.

programme.title: Professionals for a Massacre
programme.desc: During the Civil War, three outlaws face execution for selling guns to the enemy — until a Confederate general spares them. Their mission: recover a hidden fortune in gold under the watch of an officer. But rival treasure hunters turn their path to freedom into a deadly race.

programme.title: A Few Dollars for Django
programme.desc: Regan, a bounty hunter looking to start a new life, is pulled back into action when a murder sends him after bank robbers. In Montana, he steps into a range war between farmers and cattlemen while investigating. With a sheriff's star in hand, Regan must navigate dangerous territory to bring justice while seeking his own peace.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including multiple Emmy, Peabody and Edward R. Murrow Awards.

Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including multiple Emmy, Peabody and Edward R. Murrow Awards.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: End Grain Sanding Test - How High Should You Go?
programme.desc: Are there diminishing returns when sanding end grain?

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Refinish & Repurpose Cabinet Doors aka From Southwest to Contemporary
programme.desc: My mom's house is full of cabinet doors that were made in a Southwestern style and its time for a change. REPlacing the cabinets is certainly an option and just rEPlacing the doors alone would work too. But what if we could use our woodworking skills to modify the doors instead.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Wall-Hanging Tool Chest Part 3
programme.desc: This one is all about assembly! I receive a lot of requests to include more details on my assembly process. This is a detail that many articles, videos, and DVDs tend to leave out, so hopefully this helps to fill some gaps. Keep in mind that every project will require a different glueup and clamping strategy, and this is just one way to get the job done.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Durable Outdoor Finish
programme.desc: Looking for a durable outdoor finish? You've come to the right place! Looking for an inexpensive solution that will never require any maintenance? This is not the finish for you.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Lessons Learned from Past Projects
programme.desc: Ever wish you could fast forward 5 years and see how your projects are holding up? That would certainly be useful information as it would let you know what worked, and what didn’t. So in this episode, I pull out a number of old projects and examine them closely for damage, flaws and evidence of wood movement.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Road Trip to Wood Werks Supply
programme.desc: While we were in Ohio, I couldn’t resist the opportunity to visit a woodworking store that I had heard great things about: The Wood Werks Store in Columbus, OH. Pictures just can’t do this place justice! Wall to wall tools, lumber from floor to ceiling, and a Rockler store built-in! Amazing!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Marking on Dark Wood
programme.desc: Marking lines on dark wood can be difficult to see. Here are some options to consider.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cleaning Dados with a Router Plane
programme.desc: One of my all-time favorite hand tools is the router plane. However, I very rarely use it to create joinery. In my shop, its sole purpose is fine-tuning. The blade can be set at a fixed distance from the base so it is incredibly effective at creating dados and grooves of a consistent depth.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Lumber Rack aka Racking My Brain
programme.desc: The lumber rack is the unsung hero of the woodworking shop. Its responsible for holding our raw materials safely, securely, and in an organized fashion until we're ready to use them.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Assembly of a PM2000 Table Saw
programme.desc: I have been running a PM2000 in my shop for nearly 10 years and the move to Colorado afforded me the opportunity to sell the old one and replace it with a newer version that features a 50″ fence and the heavier duty workbench extension. And I thought it would be a good time to show you how to assemble a Powermatic PM2000.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Sharpen a Card Scraper
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to sharpen your card scraper.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Domino Step Stool aka One Small Step
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to easily make an elegant domino step stool.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 6
programme.desc: Now we’re really getting into the meat of the project. I show how to create a jig for the hinge mortises. I also cover the joinery being used to connect the legs to the case. I finish up by cutting the dados and rabbets in the case sides, and show you just how imperfect our machines can be. The router plane saves the day!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Create Pillowed Legs
programme.desc: Whenever I make legs for a table or chair, I find it difficult to leave them square and flat on each face. Ever since I saw David Marks pillow the outside faces of his Bubinga Coffee Table on WoodWorks, I always like to consider the possibility of using that technique to spice things up.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Fancy Workbench Cabinet With String Inlay
programme.desc: A workbench cabinet that will last for generations!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 3
programme.desc: This episode is primarily focused on the design of the legs. I present several options and show how I create a basic template. At the end, you will see the final test leg. The process of cutting the leg itself will be covered in detail when we cut the final legs out of the bubinga stock.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Simple Frame and Panel
programme.desc: I'm currently working on an Executive Desk that features large panels on the sides and front. I pondered the various ways to construct the panels along with the rails and legs that would comprise the "frame" and ultimately decided on a very simple solution: face-gluing the rails to the panels.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 11
programme.desc: I resaw the spalted maple panels on the bandsaw using Laguna’s Resaw King. What a bandsaw blade! I then glue up the doors and begin creating the ebony plugs for the case. I finish up by showing my process for fitting inset doors.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Woodworking in America 2016 Interviews
programme.desc: I had a great time at Woodworking in America 2016 and I had the opportunity to interview a few notable woodworkers from around the web. You just might recognize some of these faces.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Mortise and Tenon Options aka Tenons Anyone?
programme.desc: Learn with Marc about the most important and the strongest joints in woodworking - Mortise and Tenon joints.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Beginner’s Cutting Board From the Woodworker’s Point of View!
programme.desc: A beginner's cutting board course from the woodworker's point of view.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Aging Wood with Baking Soda
programme.desc: While you are probably familiar with the pigment and dye-based stains available on the market, you might not be aware of a whole other class of stains known as chemical stains. Woods like mahogany and cherry are great candidates for chemical staining with baking soda but a wood like maple doesn't have much change, as you'll see in the video.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: You Don't Need Breadboard Ends - Ask TWW
programme.desc: You don't need breadboard ends - and that's why.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Hidden Wireless Charging in a Desk Top
programme.desc: Wireless charging is cool. Wireless charging that is completely hidden is even cooler! When I built my Executive Desk, I knew I wanted to include wireless charging as a feature but I didn't want to look at a charging pad all the time.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 4-In-A-Row Game
programme.desc: This 4-In-A-Row Game is fun for the whole family and can be made with basic materials and tools. If you're not familiar with this classic game, the goal is to achieve four discs in a row while blocking your competitor from doing the same. The fact that it's oversized makes it that much more fun.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Safety - Tablesaw Experience
programme.desc: Whenever I have a new student in the shop, I try to convey what if feels like when something is going wrong on the tablesaw. This may seem like an abstract idea, but knowing how to identify a problem before it goes too far could give you that extra second or two you need to prevent disaster.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: The Best Way to Set Up a Bandsaw!
programme.desc: I can say without a doubt that this is the best way to set up a bandsaw.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shellac Under Polyurethane
programme.desc: I decided to do a little experiment for myself. I wanted to see if I could find any evidence of a weakened bond between polyurethane and waxed shellac, when the shellac is used in a typical manner as a sealer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Duane’s Steamer Trunk Part 3
programme.desc: I go over some pre-finishing tips and finish the inside of the trunk. I then go through the entire assembly and glueup process from start to finish. I then discuss the trunk’s lid, which is different from the original plan.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Multi-Function Toy Chest
programme.desc: The Multi-Function Toy Chest is the 2014 Woodworkers Fighting Cancer charity build.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Tour and Sub-Panel
programme.desc: Before we get too far with the renovation details, I'd like to take a minute or two to show you the garage space itself. I'm working with about 950 square feet which is pretty respectable!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: French Cleat Storage System
programme.desc: A French cleat is as ingenious as it is simple. It involves securing a strip of wood with a 45 degree bevel to the wall, and then securing an opposing beveled strip on the back of a cabinet or anything you want to hang. Its incredibly strong and versatile. Its a great way to hang cabinetry and as you’ll see in this video, it can be used to make an awesome modular wall storage unit.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Rustic Outdoor Table - Joinery and Assembly
programme.desc: A beautiful rustic table made from Western Red Cedar featuring Domino XL joinery.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Rustic Outdoor Table - Tops - Ends - Finish
programme.desc: The table top and bench tops come together along with the breadboard ends. Watco Teak Oil is used for the finish.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Setup & Tune a Tablesaw Part 1
programme.desc: Our tools are no good to us if they aren’t tuned up properly. As the “heart” of the workshop, its crucial that our table saws are configured to perform their best. So whether you are setting up a new saw, or tuning up your current one, this video guide will get you where you need to be.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: I Bought a Sawstop! - First Impressions
programme.desc: I bought a SawStop. Hopefully I won't regret it.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Basic Tool Set for the Beginning Woodworker
programme.desc: There are lots of different opinions out there as to what you actually need to do woodworking. Truth is, you don't need much. Think about our ancestors and what they were able to accomplish using only the most rudimentary tools. But in the 21st century, we aren't building for our survival and most of us have family and day jobs that come before woodworking, so we use modern tools to help us build.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Why Did My Cutting Board Split?
programme.desc: I don't know if this ever happens to you, but sometimes my tools just get out of whack and start to sound funny. Take a listen and let me know if you have any advice. Also have you ever wondered why end grain cutting boards are prone to splitting? Here's a couple of reasons why!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: DeWalt Tracksaw Review
programme.desc: Here is my review of the DeWalt Tracksaw. As much as I tried to focus solely on the Track saw, it's nearly impossible not to draw comparisons to the Festool TS line of plunge saws. Let me sum it all up by saying you need to be really picky to find distinctions that will make a real difference to the average woodworker.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Make a Vacuum Bag aka A Pressing Matter
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to make your own vacuum bag for veneer press.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Flexible Sanding Strip
programme.desc: The first time I saw a flexible sanding strip in action was while watching an episode of Woodworks going on almost 10 years ago. David Marks incorporates lots of curves in his work and the man knows a thing or two about making them. Since then, I have made numerous sanding strips in all shapes and sizes and my curves are about as perfect and smooth as they can be.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: MicroJig MJ Splitter SteelPRO
programme.desc: In the past, we have discussed the use of Featherboards & Pushsticks as well as the benefits of using something like MicroJig's GRR-Ripper. But the one safety device we have yet to focus on, which could be considered the most important, is the tablesaw splitter/riving knife.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Wiping Varnish Shootout
programme.desc: As much as for my own curiosity as everyone else's edification, I wanted to do a side by side comparison between some popular variations of wiping varnish. I've used all of these finishes in the past but I have never used them side by side. By finishing some test boards, I figured I could not only gather information about their application characteristics but also the resulting look of the finish.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 7
programme.desc: I made quite a bit of progress in this video. The legs are cut from the bubinga blanks, and I finally have an opportunity to do a dry fit. I am in for a surprise as you will see, and a change is made to the original plans.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: The Littleton Console
programme.desc: A beautiful console cabinet made from Sapele, Ambrosia Maple, and Ebony.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Mateo "The Apprentice"
programme.desc: There's only one thing more important to me than woodworking and that's family. Jersey tomato pie and BBQ are tied for third. So here's a fun little "slice of life" video of my boy enjoying a day of work in the shop.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: End Grain Sanding Test - How High Should You Go?
programme.desc: Are there diminishing returns when sanding end grain?

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Refinish & Repurpose Cabinet Doors aka From Southwest to Contemporary
programme.desc: My mom's house is full of cabinet doors that were made in a Southwestern style and its time for a change. REPlacing the cabinets is certainly an option and just rEPlacing the doors alone would work too. But what if we could use our woodworking skills to modify the doors instead.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Wall-Hanging Tool Chest Part 3
programme.desc: This one is all about assembly! I receive a lot of requests to include more details on my assembly process. This is a detail that many articles, videos, and DVDs tend to leave out, so hopefully this helps to fill some gaps. Keep in mind that every project will require a different glueup and clamping strategy, and this is just one way to get the job done.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Durable Outdoor Finish
programme.desc: Looking for a durable outdoor finish? You've come to the right place! Looking for an inexpensive solution that will never require any maintenance? This is not the finish for you.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Lessons Learned from Past Projects
programme.desc: Ever wish you could fast forward 5 years and see how your projects are holding up? That would certainly be useful information as it would let you know what worked, and what didn’t. So in this episode, I pull out a number of old projects and examine them closely for damage, flaws and evidence of wood movement.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Road Trip to Wood Werks Supply
programme.desc: While we were in Ohio, I couldn’t resist the opportunity to visit a woodworking store that I had heard great things about: The Wood Werks Store in Columbus, OH. Pictures just can’t do this place justice! Wall to wall tools, lumber from floor to ceiling, and a Rockler store built-in! Amazing!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Marking on Dark Wood
programme.desc: Marking lines on dark wood can be difficult to see. Here are some options to consider.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cleaning Dados with a Router Plane
programme.desc: One of my all-time favorite hand tools is the router plane. However, I very rarely use it to create joinery. In my shop, its sole purpose is fine-tuning. The blade can be set at a fixed distance from the base so it is incredibly effective at creating dados and grooves of a consistent depth.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Lumber Rack aka Racking My Brain
programme.desc: The lumber rack is the unsung hero of the woodworking shop. Its responsible for holding our raw materials safely, securely, and in an organized fashion until we're ready to use them.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Assembly of a PM2000 Table Saw
programme.desc: I have been running a PM2000 in my shop for nearly 10 years and the move to Colorado afforded me the opportunity to sell the old one and replace it with a newer version that features a 50″ fence and the heavier duty workbench extension. And I thought it would be a good time to show you how to assemble a Powermatic PM2000.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Sharpen a Card Scraper
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to sharpen your card scraper.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Domino Step Stool aka One Small Step
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to easily make an elegant domino step stool.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 6
programme.desc: Now we’re really getting into the meat of the project. I show how to create a jig for the hinge mortises. I also cover the joinery being used to connect the legs to the case. I finish up by cutting the dados and rabbets in the case sides, and show you just how imperfect our machines can be. The router plane saves the day!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Create Pillowed Legs
programme.desc: Whenever I make legs for a table or chair, I find it difficult to leave them square and flat on each face. Ever since I saw David Marks pillow the outside faces of his Bubinga Coffee Table on WoodWorks, I always like to consider the possibility of using that technique to spice things up.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Fancy Workbench Cabinet With String Inlay
programme.desc: A workbench cabinet that will last for generations!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 3
programme.desc: This episode is primarily focused on the design of the legs. I present several options and show how I create a basic template. At the end, you will see the final test leg. The process of cutting the leg itself will be covered in detail when we cut the final legs out of the bubinga stock.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Simple Frame and Panel
programme.desc: I'm currently working on an Executive Desk that features large panels on the sides and front. I pondered the various ways to construct the panels along with the rails and legs that would comprise the "frame" and ultimately decided on a very simple solution: face-gluing the rails to the panels.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 11
programme.desc: I resaw the spalted maple panels on the bandsaw using Laguna’s Resaw King. What a bandsaw blade! I then glue up the doors and begin creating the ebony plugs for the case. I finish up by showing my process for fitting inset doors.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Woodworking in America 2016 Interviews
programme.desc: I had a great time at Woodworking in America 2016 and I had the opportunity to interview a few notable woodworkers from around the web. You just might recognize some of these faces.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Mortise and Tenon Options aka Tenons Anyone?
programme.desc: Learn with Marc about the most important and the strongest joints in woodworking - Mortise and Tenon joints.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Beginner’s Cutting Board From the Woodworker’s Point of View!
programme.desc: A beginner's cutting board course from the woodworker's point of view.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Aging Wood with Baking Soda
programme.desc: While you are probably familiar with the pigment and dye-based stains available on the market, you might not be aware of a whole other class of stains known as chemical stains. Woods like mahogany and cherry are great candidates for chemical staining with baking soda but a wood like maple doesn't have much change, as you'll see in the video.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: You Don't Need Breadboard Ends - Ask TWW
programme.desc: You don't need breadboard ends - and that's why.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Hidden Wireless Charging in a Desk Top
programme.desc: Wireless charging is cool. Wireless charging that is completely hidden is even cooler! When I built my Executive Desk, I knew I wanted to include wireless charging as a feature but I didn't want to look at a charging pad all the time.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 4-In-A-Row Game
programme.desc: This 4-In-A-Row Game is fun for the whole family and can be made with basic materials and tools. If you're not familiar with this classic game, the goal is to achieve four discs in a row while blocking your competitor from doing the same. The fact that it's oversized makes it that much more fun.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Safety - Tablesaw Experience
programme.desc: Whenever I have a new student in the shop, I try to convey what if feels like when something is going wrong on the tablesaw. This may seem like an abstract idea, but knowing how to identify a problem before it goes too far could give you that extra second or two you need to prevent disaster.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: The Best Way to Set Up a Bandsaw!
programme.desc: I can say without a doubt that this is the best way to set up a bandsaw.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shellac Under Polyurethane
programme.desc: I decided to do a little experiment for myself. I wanted to see if I could find any evidence of a weakened bond between polyurethane and waxed shellac, when the shellac is used in a typical manner as a sealer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Duane’s Steamer Trunk Part 3
programme.desc: I go over some pre-finishing tips and finish the inside of the trunk. I then go through the entire assembly and glueup process from start to finish. I then discuss the trunk’s lid, which is different from the original plan.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Multi-Function Toy Chest
programme.desc: The Multi-Function Toy Chest is the 2014 Woodworkers Fighting Cancer charity build.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Since its premiere in 1970 the Deutsche Rallye Meisterschaft has been one of the most popular motorsports series. In the 1983 competition Opel's Manta, Kadett and Ascona sports models celebrated exceptional successes.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In 1985 Audi made their impressive mark in motorsports with the Quattro. With its 4x4 drive this model impressed the audience and shocked the competition alike and ushered in a new era in rally sports.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: After more than 20 years of abstinence Mercedes-Benz return to the Grand Prix circuit in 1954. With a lot of ambition, the company's advanced engineering and some of the best drivers in the world the Mercedes team aimed for the championship.

programme.title: Historic Formula V
programme.desc: In the late fifties in America, the first Formula V racers were produced. The goal: Affordable motor sport for everyone. The small, open wheel cars were seen on the race tracks until the end of the 70s. Then the series was stopped. About 20 years ago a couple of Formula V owners came together and established the "Historic Formula V Europe" as an association.

programme.title: Ken Block at the Monza Rallye Show
programme.desc: In Monza, Ken Block is set to compete against Allstars from motorsport at the Monza Rally Show.

programme.title: Pikes Peak International Hillclimb
programme.desc: High winds force a shortened course as drivers tackle the mountain. GT4 Trophy by Yokohama and Time Attack One classes push for top times in a demanding run where changing conditions and altitude make every second count.

programme.title: Pikes Peak International Hillclimb
programme.desc: Exhibition and Open Wheel classes tackle a shortened course due to high winds, featuring Honda’s hydrogen-powered CR-V debut and Fred Veach’s emotional farewell run on the mountain.

programme.title: Pikes Peak International Hillclimb
programme.desc: The Open Division tackles a shortened course due to high winds, featuring rookie runs, Lonni Unser’s charge, J.R. Hildebrand’s NASCAR stock car, a Michèle Mouton tribute, and Ford’s radical electric Mustang Mach-E.

programme.title: Pikes Peak International Hillclimb
programme.desc: The Unlimited Division features exotic prototypes, rookie standouts, Robin Shute in a brutal Camaro, and a fierce Nova Proto showdown between Diego De Gasperi and Simone Faggioli.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Winning the iconic Dakar Rally for a record 13 times, Frenchman Stéphane Peterhansel had a rather unusual career as he switched from motorbikes to cars and was enormously successful with both vehicles.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Alois Ruf is the founder of a small, but well-known car manufacturing company in Bavaria that specialises in building their own vision of street legal super sports cars on the foundation of Porsche bodys.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: From the 1950s to 1970s Hans Herrmann came to fame as a successful Formula 1 and sportscar driver for manufacturers like Porsche, Mercedes-Benz and Maserati who also won also the 24 Hours of Le Mans several times.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: People called her the "Queen of the Nordschleife" when she used to drive her Porsche or BMW racing cars at the Nürburgring's famous Nordschleife. Sabine Schmitz was a successful racing driver before she took a career turn by working as a TV presenter.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a rather unique type of car race in the mountains of Colorado, USA. It's exciting, tough and dangerous, and in 1987, two-time world rally champion Walter Röhrl took his Audi Sport Quattro S1 to the top.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In the 1930s the famous Silver Arrows by Auto Union that were designed by Ferdinand Porsche celebrated great successes at the European Drivers' Championship and several Grand Prix races despite the strong competition by Mercedes-Benz.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The International Championship for Manufacturers was a rally series which was run from 1970 to 1972. Car manufacturers such as Porsche, Renault, Opel and Ford took part in this competition, with Ford having an exceptionally successful year in 1972.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL Lightweight
programme.desc: An iconic racing car and one of only 29 ever built! We accompanied the Mercedes 300 SL 'lightweight' on its premiere drive at the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Bentley Mulsanne EWB
programme.desc: The long version of the Bentley Mulsanne is a prime example of a chauffeured limousine. With it, the British luxury car brand has set the bar extremely high when it comes to automotive comfort.

programme.title: Mercedes Targa Florio Racing Car from 1924 Back on the Road
programme.desc: 100 years after Mercedes' triumph in the legendary endurance race Targa Florio in Sicily in 1924, a 2-liter racing car used at that time is returning to the road. Mercedes-Benz Classic has authentically restored the vehicle.

programme.title: Mercedes Targa Florio Racing Car from 1924 on a Road Trip Around the World
programme.desc: 100 years after the triumph in the legendary Targa Florio endurance race of 1924, a Mercedes race car from that era returns to the road. The faithfully restored vehicle embarks on a world road trip to the most spectacular events, from Pebble Beach to Goodwood.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Porsche Type 64
programme.desc: The Porsche 64 was developed in parallel with the Volkswagen Beetle by Ferdinand Porsche and his son Ferry. The streamlined racing car was designed to enter the long distance race from Berlin to Rome that never took place because of the war.

programme.title: Auto Union Type C Silver Arrow
programme.desc: Every two years, cars from the past once again roar on the streets of Monte Carlo. The pinnacle of motor sports from back then, the Silver Arrow with 16 cylinders, the Auto Union Type C, still commands the highest respect from drivers today.

programme.title: Tatra T 87
programme.desc: Avantgarde on four wheels. In its day, the 1937 Tatra T 87 was considered as a car of the future

programme.title: DKW F12 Roadster
programme.desc: More than 60 years ago, the managers and workers from Ingolstadt, Germany, presented the last car manufactured under the brand name DKW, the F12 Roadster.

programme.title: Borgward Isabella Convertible
programme.desc: The German „Miss“ Wonder: The Borgward Isabella Cabriolet counts as being one of the automotive rarities from Germany.

programme.title: Chrysler Airflow
programme.desc: The representative U.S. streamlined body was too far ahead of its time . A flop at the time - now a cult classic .

programme.title: Triumph 1800 Roadster
programme.desc: Cruising like in „Miss Marple“ times. The 1947 Triumph 1800 Roadster has space for 5 fresh air fans.

programme.title: Volkswagen Karmann Ghia with a Porsche Engine
programme.desc: Take a racy Volkswagen body and pumped full of Porsche engineering. Jochen Bader has done exactly that with his 1970 Karmann Ghia. A classical hybrid of the absolutely special kind.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: The Nürburgring is the most dangerous, yet the most beautiful race track in the world and meeting point for racing icons and car rarities. The annual Sport1 Track Day lures thousands of petrol heads to the iconic track.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Ola Stenegard, Head of Vehicle Design at BMW Motorrad, meets world-famous motorcycle customizers in Los Angeles. Also: we present the craziest 'homemade supercars' such as the Fahrradi Farfalla FFX, the slowest sports car in the world.

programme.title: Lancia Stratos HF
programme.desc: The Lancia Stratos with Ferrari power, the rally icon of the 1970s.

programme.title: BMW M6 Gran Coupe
programme.desc: The M6 Gran Coupe is the latest creation from BMW's M-works subdivision. The Bavarians show that driving this V8 powered car almost feels like flying, even with the whole family on board.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Die-hard Porsche fan Marco Wendlandt makes his dream come true: driving a 1984 Porsche 911 coupe. With the help from Big Mike, a car dealer from Los Angeles, he tracks down the car in San Francisco.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: With his newly bought Porsche 911 coupe, Marco heads to L.A. to meet one of the best known Porsche enthusiasts of the world: Magnus Walker, who invites Marco to visit his workshop and his collection.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: On his way to Las Vegas Marco drops by Big Mike in the Apple Valley. Together they meet Big Mike's friends from the Kustos family, who once used to be trendsetters in the Californian car customizing scene.

programme.title: BMW 503
programme.desc: The noble four-seater 503 convertible was one of BMWs most exclusive models in the 1950s. Many international sports and movie stars and other wealthy customers were fond of this sporty luxury vehicle.

programme.title: BMW M3
programme.desc: In the late 80s BMW brought a car onto the market which carried true racing genes. Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Robust, honest, simple, the Land Rover is the bedrock of all off-road vehicles. Built in 1948 as a simple car for British farmers, the vehicle quickly became an export hit. Today, the Land Rover is at home all over the world.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Vive la différence: the cars of Renault are always unusual in design, exceptional in their driving comfort and often avant-gardistic. Renault writes history with the Dauphine, R4, R5 and R16 models.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: From the very beginning, Citroën celebrated the joy of extravagance. Already the Traction Avant from the 1950s is a milestone in automotive history and the 2CV is one of the most unusual and charming small cars ever built.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Golf is nothing more but a reasonable car - there's nothing really exciting about it, but still it's a mega-seller. The Golf is compatible with the masses and dominates the compact car class since its market introduction.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Be it the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the Monte Carlo Rally or Formula 1: Porsche won it all at least once. Even the first prototype was a race winner, and the successes of the Spyder in the Carrera Panamericana or the Targa Florio are unforgettable.

programme.title: Creme 21 Youngtimer Rally 2019
programme.desc: Welcome to the 80s, the period in time in which there were only three skin creams and three television programs on air and Tuesday night was Dallas night. - Car enthusiasts can feel like they’re back in those times once a year at the Creme 21 classic car rally.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The new BMW One M Coupe from former race car driver Ralf Kelleners: the KS1 RS. Also: Toyota present their TS 030 hybrid at the 24-hours race of Le Mans. And: Subaru's XV crossover stands out from the company's model range.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The 'little' Mercedes-Benz S250 with a four-cylinder engine needs so little fuel that one could call this car a piggybank. Also: the power packages Nissan 370 Z and Wiesmann GT MF5. And: the ADAC Eco Test.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The new Porsche Boxter, a real open-top sports car. Also: Volkswagen presents the new Passat Alltrack, a real allrounder. And: Fiat's successful Panda model in its third generation version.

programme.title: Mercedes Sprinter, 2018

programme.title: Arden AJ23

programme.title: Tuning

programme.title: Tuning

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The MF5 GT, the powerhouse from Wiesmann. What's more: if you're looking for exclusivity and find even the performance of a Mercedes-AMG too low, you've come to the right place. The Brabus company is one of the most famous tuners in the world.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The International Motor Show in Geneva is the first important vehicle fair of the year. Of course, the top class refiners must not be missing. Also: the Mercedes-AMG SL 63. The sixth generation of the SL is more powerful than ever before.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The tuning forge MTM is known for its extremely dynamic, optimally tuned vehicles. What's more: the Nissan Juke-R is a projectile with the dimensions of a cigar box and 485 hp of power.

programme.title: Mercedes-AMG GT S Performmaster
programme.desc: Not far from Stuttgart is the home of the tuner Performmaster who specialize in the performance optimization of Mercedes-AMG models. They turned the already more-than-potent GT S sports car into a beast.

programme.title: Lancia Stratos HF
programme.desc: The Lancia Stratos with Ferrari power, the rally icon of the 1970s.

programme.title: Ken Block - Gymkhana Grid
programme.desc: Spectacular drifts are to be expected when Ken Block visits the Gymkhana Grid.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: An angry bull, a few Englishmen who prepared themselves for rather unpleasant weather conditions and a young, talented race driver, these were all visitors who ventured to the infamous Green Hell of the Nürburgring.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: A tuned-up Golf 2, a family sedan from Hanover, Germany and a very special Porsche GT2. We looked behind the scenes of the gas station by the curve on the race track where sports cars flock.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: When the Nürburgring transforms into a winter wonderland, it may look pleasant but sure isn't too pleasant as a race track.

programme.title: Trackmasters

programme.title: Jaguar XJR
programme.desc: The highlight of the XJR lies beneath the hood: all of Jaguar's top models are equipped with the 5-liter V8 compressor engine that delivers 550 HP in this sports sedan.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Bentley New Flying Spur and the Rolls Royce Wraith are both an extremely exclusive breed of cars. These luxurious power packs make for an almost transcendental driving experience and deliver the perfect combination of elegance and performance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: There are names that sound like music in car enthusiasts' ears: the Mc Laren MP4 12C, the Porsche 911 Turbo S and the Mercedes SLS AMG GT are super sports cars that are second to none. We put the pedal to the metal in these exciting and powerful driving machines.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: 1,000 kilometers on the famous Nurburgring. It's the final race of the 2013 season. The Blancpain Endurance Series is a racing event for grand tourers like the Ferrari 458 Italia, the McLaren MP4-12 C or the Nissan GT-R Nismo GT3. We took a look at all the action, the drivers, their cars and the competition.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL Lightweight
programme.desc: An iconic racing car and one of only 29 ever built! We accompanied the Mercedes 300 SL 'lightweight' on its premiere drive at the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: With the Bentley Bentayga, the traditional British brand is entering the fastest growing market segment. This world's first luxury SUV is a conglomerate of superlatives on wheels.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The sixth generation of the Opel Corsa shows its sporty side. Also: automotive minimalism in perfection, the Mitsubishi Space Star. And: the 2020 Seat Leon takes on the VW Golf again.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Can the new Mercedes-Benz C-Class and Skoda Octavia models continue to ride the wave of success? Also: the new generation of the Nissan Quashqai and the Opel Astra. And: the history of the Mercedes-Benz C-Class.

programme.title: All-rounders
programme.desc: We take a look at all-rounders such as the Volkswagen Caddy or the new T7. In addition: both Opel and Nissan offer electric variants for their Combo and Townstar models respectively.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Minivans offer an ideal blend of functionality, versatility and comfort that has been appreciated for generations. The Mercedes V-Class has to prove itself in six disciplines. And can the fully electric ID. Buzz continue the legacy of the Volkswagen Transporter?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Minivans offer space for family, friends and adventures and are popular due to their practical size and functionality. We test the Mercedes V-Class, Opel Zafira-e and VW T7 in everyday use and show what you need to look out for in car subscriptions.

programme.title: Alpina B6
programme.desc: An Alpina is optically never intrusive. Understatement is the motto. One should not recognize at first glance, what potential is hidden under the bodywork. Huge spoilers are not used and neither are striking power domes. Any modifications serve the technical improvement, for example, optimized cooling and aerodynamics.

programme.title: Porsche Panamera
programme.desc: In the second generation Porsche Panamera, practically everything is different. Optics, technology, handling. Porsche's main goal is to provide the perfect combination of sportiness and comfort.

programme.title: Ignition GT

There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: My Daughter is a Zombie [English Dub]

One day, Su-a becomes infected by a zombie virus that has swept across the globe. In a desperate bid to protect her, Jeong-hwan takes Su-a to Eunbong-ri, a seaside village where his mother, Kim Bam-sun, lives. Amid growing societal pressure to root out the infected, Jeong-hwan notices that Su-a, despite being a zombie, vaguely understands human speech and reacts to her favorite things: dancing and her grandmother’s sharp but loving flicks of the hand. Refusing to give up on her, Jeong-hwan draws on his years of experience as a tiger trainer and begins an intensive training program for his zombie daughter. A training journey more terrifying than handling a tiger and more difficult than dealing with teenage angst begins. The most heartwarming and hilarious top-secret project is about to unfold!
